# Abdul Wahid — AI/ML Developer

> Portfolio of Abdul Wahid, an Artificial Intelligence undergraduate at COMSATS University Islamabad (Attock Campus) and a machine-learning developer focused on explainable AI (XAI), model evaluation and MLOps. His work pairs predictive models with the evidence around them: experiment tracking, SHAP explainability, APIs and usable interfaces.

## About

- Education: BS Artificial Intelligence, COMSATS University Islamabad — Attock Campus (2024–2028).
- Experience: Machine Learning Intern at Ezitech Institute (Eziline Software House), Islamabad — healthcare ML with XGBoost/LightGBM (best 0.83 AUC-ROC), MLflow experiment tracking, SHAP explanations served through FastAPI, Docker and drift monitoring.
- Skills: Python, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, MLflow, SHAP; FastAPI, Flask, Next.js, React; MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase; Git/GitHub, Vercel, Docker.

## Selected projects

- MediSight AI: an explainable healthcare risk-modelling workflow with model evaluation, experiment tracking and a clinician-facing interface.
- Customer Churn Prediction: a supervised-learning study comparing classifiers for churn (84% accuracy, 71% F1).
- Study Hub (FA24-BAI): a course-materials hub built and maintained for his whole university cohort — https://fa24-bai.vercel.app
- Predictly: a Pakistani real-estate price prediction project.
- NearSend, Churnex, EPMS: additional software and ML projects documented on the portfolio site and GitHub.
